rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something uncomplicated, and also for a plain or unadorned appearance.

example.english: This method is simple, so you don't need to study for long.
example.traditional: 呢個做法好簡單，唔使學好耐。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zou6 faat3 hou2 gaan2 daan1 m4 sai2 hok6 hou2 noi6

rows.note: Use this specifically when “simple” means easy or not difficult.

example.english: This exercise is simple, so try it yourself.
example.traditional: 呢份練習好易，你自己試吓啦。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 lin6 zaap6 hou2 ji6 nei5 zi6 gei2 si3 haa5 laa1

rows.note: Use this for a person who is guileless, innocent, or not complicated in motives.

example.english: He is very simple and doesn't know how to guard against people.
example.traditional: 佢個人好單純，唔識提防人。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 jan4 hou2 daan1 seon4 m4 sik1 tai4 fong4 jan4

rows.note: Use this when “simple” is disparaging and means foolish or dim-witted.

example.english: You're really simple—you got even this little thing wrong.
example.traditional: 你真係蠢，咁少少嘢都做錯。
example.jyutping: nei5 zan1 hai6 ceon2 gam3 siu2 siu2 je5 dou1 zou6 co3
